simple.meaning: אֲשֵׁדָה (ʼăshêdâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a ravine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲשֵׁדָה (H794) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 3:17, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Joshua.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲשֵׁדָה (H794) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲשֵׁדָה (H794) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲשֵׁדָה (ʼăshêdâh) / H794 is traced through Deuteronomy 3:17, Deuteronomy 4:49, Joshua 10:40, Joshua 12:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
